params.body:
## What changes on /transports

**Columns line up with their headers.** The date sat hard right (`text-end`) under a left-aligned header, with an empty stretch of action column after it; the price was left-aligned. One rule for the table now: text and dates left under a left header, money right under a right header, never wrapped (`€ 257,73`), tabular figures from `ui-list`. The action column shrinks to its buttons (`w-px`), so there is no phantom column. The same price fix on the worklist transport widget (`worklist/widgets/5`). The empty-list row spanned 9/8 columns for a table of 10/8; fixed.

**Number and Dealer only for the administrator.** A garage sees only its own transports, so the Dealer column was already admin-only; the Number is the internal id, which is the office's reference (it is in the office mails `price_requested_admin` and `mails/transport`), so it stays for the administrator and leaves the garage view (column, filter field and sort entry).

**Row actions per state.** Each row now carries what its state allows, through the routes the detail window already uses (they check the owner and the state again), inside `@can('use-transport')`:
- "Bevestig en betaal" (or "Betaal" for a started payment) while a price is there, a link to `transport.update.pay` (R S4-10.9);
- the next planning step after payment, `transport.update.next` (R S4-10.11);
- cancel before payment, `transport.update.cancel`, after a `ui.confirm` with `danger` (R S4-10.12); the detail window still cancels without asking, that window is not touched here;
- always the transport itself (the eye, or the truck that opens the request while it is pending).

Next step and cancel go through one delegated click handler on the page (`[data-transport-post]`: confirm, POST with the CSRF header, reload, or `ui.notify` with the server's message on an error). No new globals, no new `onclick=`.

**The Acties menu.** It holds the bulk planning steps for the rows ticked with the checkbox (R S4-10.11, documented, so kept), but the checkbox only exists on a paid transport. On a page without one the menu acted on nothing. It now renders only when at least one row on the page can be selected.

**Also.** The status `pickup_confirmed` showed the raw key `transport.pickup_confirmed`: the label was missing in all five languages; added, with the texts for the new buttons and the cancel question. A `ui-button` link inside a `ui-list` took the list's link colour (blue on blue); `.ui-list a:not(.ui-action-button)` now also excludes `.ui-button` (same two lines, no new rule).

## Rules

- R S4-10.11: the Acties menu only when a row can be selected.
- R S4-10.13: Number and Dealer only for the administrator.
- R S4-10.21 (new): the row actions per state, the alignment of price and date.

## Tests

`TransportOverviewRowsTest` (new): a garage sees neither number nor dealer and the administrator sees both; price right under a right header, date left; the actions per state (price available, price requested, paid, completed); cancel carries the confirm question and the page asks before it posts, then the route cancels; the bulk menu and checkbox only with a paid row; without the Gate the overview redirects and pay is 403. `ListPageHeadersTest` now adds a paid transport so the menu it checks is there. `blade_onclick` budget 248 to 246 (two inline handlers became Alpine/data attributes).

Ran locally: the transport tests, `ListPageHeadersTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `TheThemeOverrulesEverySpacingClassTest`, `QualityRatchetTest`, `LanguageParityTest`, the rules tests. The full suite is left to CI (the local machine was saturated).

## Screenshots

Before and after at 1440 and 390, garage user and administrator, sample data with one transport in every state. Cancel on a row asks first and the row shows Geannuleerd after the reload (checked in a browser).
params.title: Transport overview: columns that line up, actions on the row, a bulk menu only when it can act
